html:
Grab is a technology company based in Singapore that runs a "super-app" for rides, food delivery and payments across Southeast Asia. It began in 2012 in Malaysia as MyTeksi, a taxi-booking app.

Its founders, Anthony Tan and Tan Hooi Ling, were Malaysians who had met at business school. They wanted to make taxi rides safer and fairer in Kuala Lumpur, where drivers often refused the meter. The app spread to the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam and Indonesia, and the company moved its headquarters to Singapore in 2014.

  • In 2018 it bought the Southeast Asian business of Uber, which pulled out of the region.
  • It added food delivery, parcels, payments and loans, so that one app covers much of daily life.
  • In 2021 it listed its shares on the Nasdaq exchange in New York.

Its main rival is the Indonesian company Gojek. Grab is part of the rise of a Southeast Asian internet economy built on cheap smartphones and a young population.
sum: Grab is a technology company based in Singapore that runs a "super-app" for rides, food delivery and payments across Southeast Asia. It began in 2012 in Malaysia as MyTeksi, a taxi-booking app.
